Record Class RegistrationEmailEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.client.RegistrationEmailEvent
Record Components:
kind - which email to send
to - the address to send it to
link - the link that confirms the email and opens the account; only set for RegistrationEmailEvent.Kind.VERIFY
expiresAt - when that link stops working; only set for RegistrationEmailEvent.Kind.VERIFY
details - which of the recipient's details the application used; only set for RegistrationEmailEvent.Kind.DETAILS_REUSED. Never the values themselves.
public record RegistrationEmailEvent(RegistrationEmailEvent.Kind kind, String to, String link, Instant expiresAt, Set<RegistrationEmailEvent.Detail> details) extends Record
Published when a registration request needs an email sent, so it goes out once the request has committed. Every request emails the address it was submitted with: the response never says how the application went, so the email is where the applicant finds out.
